description:
Bare type-name resolution is inconsistent, so type annotations work for some built-in types and silently fail for others. This is foundational: protocol dispatch (fz-bin) and any typed-dispatch over collections trips over it, so fix it first.

GROUNDED in classify_name (src/compiler2/resolve.rs:324) and builtin_from_name (resolve.rs:397):
- 'list' is SPECIAL-CASED (NameClass::List, parametric list(inner), resolve.rs:332).
- 'resource' is special-cased (NameClass::Resource).
- builtin_from_name covers: nil, bool, integer, float, cpointer, binary, atom, any, never, utf8, pid, ref.
- EVERYTHING ELSE falls through to a type-alias lookup (NameClass::Named); if no alias is defined it is NameClass::Unknown -> 'unknown type name'.

CONSEQUENCES (measured):
- ':: list' resolves; ':: map' fails with 'unknown type name map' (map is neither special-cased, a builtin, nor an alias). 'tuple', 'keyword' similarly have no bare name.
- List.t / Map.t are NOT defined in the runtime library (list.fz/map.fz have no @type t), so ':: List.t' / ':: Map.t' are unresolved too (and a recursive/unresolved alias can hang the driver).
- Net: collection types have no uniform, resolvable type name -- you cannot write a typed clause head that dispatches on 'is a map' or 'is a list' uniformly.

FIX (make it uniform and complete -- choose and apply consistently):
- Give every built-in type a resolvable bare name: add 'map' (-> map_top, parametric map(k,v)?), 'tuple', and audit the set against the Types surface; OR
- Define canonical Module.t aliases in the runtime library for List/Map/(Range exists)/etc. and route bare collection names through them; OR both.
- Prefer removing the ad-hoc 'list'/'resource' special cases in favor of one consistent mechanism (builtin table and/or library aliases), so there is a single source of truth for type-name resolution.

VERIFY: ':: map', ':: list', ':: tuple' (as applicable) all resolve and dispatch; add type_expr resolution tests; lib+matrix green. RELATED: fz-bv3 (Region::Type over a struct type panics) is the sibling foundational gap for STRUCT dispatch -- together they make typed dispatch over the full value space sound. This ticket BLOCKS fz-bin.1 (protocol-dispatch synthesis), which otherwise must hand-build IR to dodge the gap.
title: [BUG] Inconsistent/incomplete built-in type-name resolution (list special-cased, map/tuple unresolvable, no Module.t aliases)
